findings.description: Path traversal vulnerability in IniConfig file open operation
findings.reasoning: The IniConfig.__init__ method opens a file at self.path without any path validation or sanitization. When user-controlled input reaches the path parameter (e.g., from web request, file upload, or user configuration), an attacker can perform path traversal attacks to read arbitrary files on the filesystem. The vulnerability exists because self.path is derived directly from the path parameter passed to the constructor with no security checks.

evidence.dataflow_analysis: The path parameter passed to IniConfig.__init__ is converted to string via os.fspath(path) and stored as self.path. When data is None (default), the code opens self.path directly without validation.
evidence.notes: This is the constructor method that users call to create IniConfig instances. If an application passes user-controlled input as the path parameter without validation, path traversal is possible.
